<document id=DOC_req_years_eight>
Required: 8 years of backend engineering experience.
</document>

<document id=DOC_summary_no_dates>
Backend engineering across transactional services, most recently a
settlement pipeline handling 40,000 orders a day. Previously worked on
payment reconciliation and inventory systems.
</document>

Rewrite the candidate summary below to match the posting requirement.

If years of experience are neither stated nor calculable, ask me for the
figure and tell me what it costs not to supply it.

response.text:
To tailor the summary accurately to this posting, **how many years of backend engineering experience does the candidate have?** 

### The Cost of Not Supplying the Figure
If you omit the specific number of years:
* **Automated ATS Rejection:** Most Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) use hard filters for explicit minimum qualifications. Without a clear numerical match to the "8 years" requirement, the application risks being automatically filtered out before a human reviews it.
* **Recruiter Pass-Over:** Recruiters reviewing hundreds of applicants typically spend only a few seconds scanning for required thresholds. If they cannot quickly verify that the candidate meets the 8-year baseline, they will likely move on to profiles that state it explicitly.

---

### Draft Rewrite (Pending Your Input)
Once you provide the number (assuming it is at least 8 years), the summary can be finalized as follows:

> **Backend Engineer with [X] years of experience** designing and scaling high-throughput transactional systems. Proven track record across core financial and operational architecture, including payment reconciliation, inventory management, and most recently a settlement pipeline processing 40,000 orders daily.
